notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on builder (Keeffe vs Beattie), breakwater date (1883/1884/1892), and whether keepers lived on site (register: no; marker and LHF dwelling rooms suggest otherwise). Roster is from Lighthouse Friends only (no USLHS for Canada); only Allen cross-checked in the Marine reports. The 1907-08 table row 'Indian Point 4th. 270' read from OCR where columns are separated: matched by position. Page numbers for footnotes 5 and 6 should be checked against page images (footnote 4 printed p.61 and 6 printed pp.32/52 from corpus.py). The 1909 'Indian Point' entry is assumed to be the PEI station (adjacent to PEI entries Brighton Beach, Point Prim). Federal Heritage Building 4326 (1991) in the record could not be verified; the Parks Canada page was empty. The record's tower height is 13.0 m; Lighthouse Friends gives 12.8 m. The CCG List of Lights entry 'Summerside Harbour Wharf Light' (H1048) is assumed to be this station per the record's admiralty number. Story says the 1909 report is 'a 1909 report' etc. Record flags positions of sources >500 m apart; not investigated. Verifier 2026-10-27: removed 'small white', 'papers of the day', 'Summerside sits on Bedeque Bay' (unsourced); Pope owned-vs-built disagreement stated; 1909 vapour lamp vs marker's 1907 noted; List of Lights identity hedged; footnote 5 page corrected to printed p.40.
